sections.criterion: Quality and efficiency of the implementation

consistency_log.description: Objective consistency across Excellence and Implementation sections, cross-checked against Tier 3 objectives.
WP reference consistency: WP IDs cited in Excellence and Impact resolve to the canonical WP1-WP7 list in Implementation.
Partner name consistency: all partner tokens P01-P12 used in the sections match the pseudonymous legal_name tokens in Tier 3 partners.json, with no suffix or variant mismatch.

Deliverable ID consistency: deliverable IDs and titles cited in Impact (D2.1, D2.2, D3.1-D3.4, D4.1, D4.4, D5.3, D6.1-D6.3, D7.1-D7.4, D1.1, D1.3) match the 24-row deliverable table in Implementation.
Milestone ID consistency: milestone references align with the MS1-MS8 milestone table and milestone_refs in Implementation; Impact asserts no conflicting milestone IDs.
KPI consistency: all three sections state twelve indicators, each naming one deliverable, with no target numbers set because participation is unconfirmed.

Impact claim grounding: each Impact claim cites a WP or deliverable (e.g. D2.2, D4.4, D5.3, D6.2, WP5) present in the Implementation work plan; the valuation-clause gap is flagged consistently in both sections.
Budget/resource claim consistency: all three sections state EUR 5,000,000 per project, about two projects funded, a lump-sum regime computed externally, and person-months not yet agreed.
consistency_log.source_basis: EUR 5M per project and lump-sum regime confirmed from Tier 3 selected_call.json, asserted identically across all three section artifacts

consistency_log.description: Terminology consistency: key canonical terms (multisensory integration architecture, single agricultural pressure gradient, genome-to-space, leakage-safe split, European habitat classification/EUNIS, global ecosystem typology, EOSC, common data spaces, Copernicus/Galileo/EGNOS) are used in full and consistently across sections, with no stem-only variant.
Section ordering and completeness: all three sections are present and ordered Excellence (B.1), Impact (B.2), Implementation (B.3), matching the RIA/IA Part B template structure.
consistency_log.source_basis: Tier 2A RIA/IA application form (af_he-ria-ia_en); sub_section_ids B.1.x / B.2.x / B.3.x in the three section artifacts

consistency_log.description: Traceability footer consistency: each section has a non-empty primary_sources array and no_unsupported_claims_declaration true; each overall_status is 'assumed' (not 'unresolved'), so the declaration is consistent with the status.

Validation status aggregation (informational): Excellence 'assumed', Impact 'assumed', Implementation 'assumed'. No section is 'unresolved'. The uniform assumed status reflects unconfirmed consortium participation and is carried forward for downstream review.

traceability_footer.derivation_note: Assembled draft inherits section-level proposal claim traceability from referenced section artifacts; this artifact adds only section index and cross-section consistency findings.
